sources.description: Archival pre-restoration photos, plan and technical-specification sheet from BIUTOPIC Erdre municipal proposal v19.
Generic Renaud 8000 interior plan; not a measured as-built refit.
Restored interior reference from the user dossier.
Different model-level weight and capacities; retained as unresolved alternatives.
8 x 3 m, interior layout and exterior reference photographs.
7.99 x 2.96 m, 0.8 m draft, 2.2 m air draft; different installed tanks/engine, not adopted as this vessel measurements.

assumptions: Outer shape, cabin heights and window proportions are fitted reference geometry, not surveyed construction dimensions.

Archived sheet visible in the user dossier reads 8 m, 2.98 m, 0.75 m draft, 2.30 m air draft, light weight 2.1 T, water 350 litres and fuel 64 litres. These historical model values do not establish the current restored boat loading.
Fluvial model page separately reports 3000 kg, 0.8 m draft, 2.2 m air draft, 575 L water and 150 L fuel. Those differing conditions are not resolved or averaged.
Boat mass is assigned once to a parent as a provisional 2100 kg reference. No invented hull, roof, furniture, engine or tank mass breakdown is added.
Interior geometry follows the recovered generic layout and restored-interior photos; exact current interior measurements are unknown.
No EXO frame, external batteries, solar panels or external floats are included. The EXO remains a separate model; attachment geometry and shared-load accounting remain unresolved.
No current displacement, equilibrium, centre of gravity, inertia, capacity, wave response or structural strength is calculated.
